mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stress_task (task_name, engine_type, target_url, app_name, app_version, method, concurrency, duration_sec, qps_limit, status) VALUES (#{taskName}, #{engineType}, #{targetUrl}, #{appName}, #{appVersion}, #{method}, #{concurrency}, #{durationSec}, #{qpsLimit}, 'pending')
mapper.update: UPDATE stress_task SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE stress_task SET result_json = #{resultJson} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: id, task_name, engine_type, target_url, app_name, app_version, method, concurrency, duration_sec, qps_limit, status, result_json, error_msg, create_time, finish_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM stress_task WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
